Hi Marta — thanks for the files, they look good at a glance. Quick responses below and a short checklist so we can close activation: 

Checklist for final activation:
1) Vendor onboarding form (received, signed) — OK
2) Bank proof (voided check + bank letter) — OK; will accept bank letter instead of micro-deposits for ACH if letter includes account and routing AND is on bank letterhead
3) W9 (required for US vendors) — please attach if available; if not, indicate N/A and we’ll flag for tax team
4) Invoice labeling: We require the PO number in the invoice filename and the invoice header. Preferred filename pattern: PO{PO_NUMBER}_{INVOICE_DATE}_{VENDORNAME}.pdf (e.g., PO12345_20280418_Cascade.pdf). We’ll also ingest CSV header "po_number" if you send bulk uploads.

Ben and Priyom — looping you in for payment path and PO mapping decisions.

Next steps: Marta, once you confirm W9 or indicate it's N/A, Ben will trigger the payments activation and send an ACH test schedule.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_invoice_labeling_guidelines.pdf

- Expected timeline: once W9 is provided and our vendor portal record is complete, we can schedule activation in the next 3 business days. I’ll post the exact activation window here.

Marta — please confirm the legal business name that should appear on the vendor portal (full name + DBA if any). Also confirm the remittance email you want on invoices (defaults to payments@cascade-supply.com).
